newsitem.title: USA: Pinnacle stake cut by Jacobs group.
newsitem.headline: Pinnacle stake cut by Jacobs group.

text.p: A group led by Minneapolis investor Irwin Jacobs said Tuesday it cut its stake in Pinnacle Systems Inc to 336,700 common shares or 4.48 percent from 7.96 percent previously held.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include shares sold between April 24 and May 6 at prices ranging from $14.375 to $16.468 per share.
Pinnacle Systems, based in Santa Clara, is engaged in design, manufacture and marketing of high performance, cost effective video work stations.
